title: Reva
description: Inquisitor Reva was the Third Sister. Once a Jedi Youngling, she was recruited by the Inquisitor corps after the fell of the Old Republic. As she advanced in the Inquisitor ranks, she secretly wanted revenge on Darth Vader for killing her fellow Youngling. Defeated by Vader, Reva attempted to kill young Luke Skywalker, but realized she was wrong.
